temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria notices Cheryl looking stressed and overwhelmed by stacks of paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; Cheryl accepts Maria's offer of help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria has no specific prior belief that Cheryl is struggling; she sees Cheryl as a colleague working on the project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria learns Cheryl is currently overwhelmed and receptive to assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl needs and welcomes help with the project's paperwork and planning.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and willing to help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing in confidence; in the staff meeting, Maria suggests Cheryl lead the next phase, and Cheryl thanks her and accepts the role.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl had been overwhelmed but has potential and has benefited from support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria's belief strengthens from Cheryl needing support to Cheryl being capable, committed, and ready for leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready to lead the next phase and appreciates Maria's confidence in her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl's leadership of the next phase of the project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria approaches Cheryl privately and learns Cheryl was a bit surprised by the leadership suggestion but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl may have felt pressured or that Maria overstepped by suggesting her for leadership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria's worry is relieved; Cheryl does not seem to resent the suggestion and values Maria's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl feels supported rather than pressured and that their relationship remains positive.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worried and anxious before the conversation; relieved and reassured afterward.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clarify her intentions, ensure Cheryl feels supported, and maintain open, respectful communication.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria feels relieved that Cheryl valued her honesty and support; she proposes that they co-lead the project, and Cheryl enthusiastically agrees, saying Maria's guidance is invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl appreciates her support and that their relationship is positive, and she wants to continue collaborating effectively.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Maria's belief expands from supporting Cheryl's leadership to Cheryl welcoming an equal co-leading partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes she and Cheryl can co-lead effectively and that Cheryl values Maria's guidance and mutual support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and support each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees that she and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects and that their partnership has strengthened; when Maria raises future projects, Cheryl says she would love that and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes their co-leading partnership has been successful and that they work well together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change; the belief is reinforced and deepened. Maria learns Cheryl wants more future collaboration and shares her excitement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes their partnership is fruitful, synergistic, and has strong potential for future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future.
